column1: 1. For discrete input source selection, please program a code sequence of "INPUT" + (2 second delay) + numeric key.  The numeric key is the position count of the desired input source in the input selection menu (1 for Blu-ray Player, 2 for HDMI IN, and so on).
2. For selecting a picture adjustment preset mode, please program a code sequence of "Picture Adj." + Numeric key 1, 2 or 3 + "SETUP".  The numeric key selects a preset picture mode.
